title: Carbon dot-modified silver nanoparticle electrochemical sensors for the ultrasensitive detection of total malachite green and leucomalachite green residues in fish
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17149-17157
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01261B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Pomi Bi Boussou Narcisse, Aka Alla Martin, Essy Kouadio Fodjo, Guangxin Yang, Cong Kong, Zhen Gu, Koffi Koffi Kra Sylvestre, Irié Bi Irié Williams
Green approach synthesis of silver nanoparticle-covered carbon dots led to ultrasensitive sensor by modifying Au electrode. This sensor was applied for detection of total malachite green and leucomalachite green residues with low limit of detection.
